description.en: What GDP counts and what it leaves out, nominal against real GDP, the GDP deflator and inflation, and the quantity theory of money and the nominal interest rate.
description.zh: GDP 计算什么、不计算什么，名义 GDP 和实际 GDP，GDP 平减指数和通胀，以及货币数量论和名义利率。

description.en: Reading the growth of nominal GDP as growth in what is produced
description.zh: 把名义 GDP 的增长当成产量的增长

title.en: Predicted question 8, as it could be printed

paras.en: An economy produces only pizzas and haircuts. In 2024 it produced 100 pizzas at \$10 and 50 haircuts at \$20; in 2025, 120 pizzas at \$11 and 60 haircuts at \$24.
paras.zh: 某经济体只生产比萨和理发。2024 年生产了 100 个比萨，每个 10，和 50 次理发，每次 20；2025 年生产了 120 个比萨，每个 11，和 60 次理发，每次 24。

paras.en: **a.** Calculate nominal GDP in both years, real GDP in 2025 at 2024 prices, and the growth rate of real GDP. (4 marks)
paras.zh: **a.** 计算两年的名义 GDP、以 2024 年价格计算的 2025 年实际 GDP，以及实际 GDP 增长率。（4 分）

paras.en: **b.** Calculate the GDP deflator for 2025 (2024 = 100) and the inflation rate it shows. (2 marks)
paras.zh: **b.** 计算 2025 年的 GDP 平减指数（2024 = 100），以及它反映的通胀率。（2 分）

paras.en: **c.** For each, say whether it counts in this economy's 2025 GDP, and why: (i) a used car sold in 2025; (ii) flour bought by a pizza shop; (iii) a pension paid by the government; (iv) a new house built in 2025. (4 marks)
paras.zh: **c.** 下面各项是否计入该经济体 2025 年的 GDP，为什么：(i) 2025 年卖出的一辆二手车；(ii) 比萨店买的面粉；(iii) 政府发的养老金；(iv) 2025 年新建的一栋房子。（4 分）

paras.en: **d.** The money supply grows 8% a year, real GDP 3% a year, and the velocity of money is constant. Use the quantity theory of money to find the inflation rate. If lenders want a real interest rate of 2%, what nominal interest rate will they charge? (4 marks)
paras.zh: **d.** 货币供应量每年增长 8%，实际 GDP 每年增长 3%，货币流通速度不变。用货币数量论求通胀率。如果贷款人要求 2% 的实际利率，他们会收多少名义利率？（4 分）

title.en: Why this is a likely question
title.zh: 为什么这道题很可能考

body.en: Measuring GDP opens the course, and money, inflation, interest rates and policy are part of its macroeconomics; the mock had none of them. Treat this one as the least certain of the eight: the lectures may weight it differently.
body.zh: 衡量 GDP 是这门课的第一讲，货币、通胀、利率和政策也属于它的宏观部分；模考一样都没考。把这道题看作八道里最不确定的一道：课上的侧重可能不同。

items.en: **Nominal GDP**: everything produced, valued at that year's prices. **Real GDP**: the same quantities valued at the prices of a base year (here 2024), so that only quantities can change it.
items.zh: **名义 GDP**：所有产出按当年价格计价。**实际 GDP**：同样的数量按基年（这里是 2024 年）价格计价，这样只有数量能让它变化。

items.en: **GDP deflator**: a price index made from the two: nominal GDP divided by real GDP, times 100.
items.zh: **GDP 平减指数**：由两者算出的价格指数：名义 GDP 除以实际 GDP，再乘 100。

items.en: **Velocity of money**: how many times a dollar is spent on output in a year. The **quantity theory** links money to prices through it.
items.zh: **货币流通速度**：一块钱一年里被用来买产出的次数。**货币数量论**通过它把货币和价格联系起来。

title.en: Nominal and real: separating prices from quantities
title.zh: 名义与实际：把价格和数量分开

paras.en: Calculate nominal GDP in both years, real GDP in 2025 at 2024 prices, and the growth rate of real GDP.
paras.zh: 计算两年的名义 GDP、以 2024 年价格计算的 2025 年实际 GDP，以及实际 GDP 增长率。

text.en: **GDP** is the market value of all *final* goods and services produced in a country in a period. To add pizzas and haircuts, value each at its price. That gives nominal GDP, which rose from 2000 to 2760, by 38%. But part of that rise is only prices going up: the economy did not produce 38% more.
text.zh: **GDP** 是一个国家在一段时间内生产的全部*最终*商品和服务的市场价值。要把比萨和理发加在一起，就按各自的价格计价。这就是名义 GDP，从 2000 增到 2760，涨了 38%。但其中一部分只是价格在涨：经济并没有多生产 38%。

text.en: To see the quantities alone, value 2025's output at 2024's prices: real GDP. If every quantity rose 20% (as here: 100 → 120 pizzas, 50 → 60 haircuts), real GDP rises exactly 20%. That is the growth an economist means by *economic growth*.
text.zh: 要只看数量，就把 2025 年的产出按 2024 年的价格计价：这就是实际 GDP。如果每样东西的数量都涨了 20%（这里正是这样：比萨 100 → 120，理发 50 → 60），实际 GDP 就正好涨 20%。经济学家说的*经济增长*指的就是它。

prompt.en: Nominal GDP rose 38% while real GDP rose 20%. What does the gap mean?
prompt.zh: 名义 GDP 涨了 38%，实际 GDP 涨了 20%。差距说明什么？

feedback.en: Only 20% more; the rest is higher prices.
feedback.zh: 只多生产了 20%；其余是价格上涨。

label.en: Prices rose: the rest of the nominal increase is inflation
label.zh: 价格上涨了：名义增长中多出来的部分是通胀

feedback.en: Real GDP is meant to leave out price changes.
feedback.zh: 实际 GDP 本来就是要剔除价格变化。

explain.zh: 名义增长 ≈ 实际增长 + 通胀：$1.38 = 1.20 \times 1.15$。

say.en: Nominal GDP 2024: quantities at that year's prices.
say.zh: 2024 年名义 GDP：数量乘当年价格。
2025 年实际 GDP：2025 年的数量乘 2024 年的价格。

say.en: Real growth (2024's real GDP equals its nominal, as the base year).
say.zh: 实际增长率（基年 2024 年的实际 GDP 等于名义 GDP）。

say.en: (b) The deflator: nominal over real, times 100.
say.zh: (b) 平减指数：名义除以实际，乘 100。

say.en: Inflation: the rise in the deflator from the base year's 100.
say.zh: 通胀率：平减指数从基年的 100 上升了多少。

outro.en: **Answer:** nominal GDP 2000 (2024) and 2760 (2025); real GDP 2025 = 2400; real growth 20%; deflator 115, inflation 15%.

prompt.zh: 2025 年的数量乘 2024 年的价格。

paras.en: Say whether each counts in this economy's 2025 GDP, and why: (i) a used car sold in 2025; (ii) flour bought by a pizza shop; (iii) a pension paid by the government; (iv) a new house built in 2025.
paras.zh: 下面各项是否计入 2025 年 GDP，为什么：(i) 2025 年卖出的一辆二手车；(ii) 比萨店买的面粉；(iii) 政府发的养老金；(iv) 2025 年新建的一栋房子。

text.en: Every item is a test of one word in the definition: *market value* of *final* goods and services *produced* in the country *in the period*.
text.zh: 每一项都是在考定义里的一个词：本国*在这段时间内生产*的*最终*商品和服务的*市场价值*。

items.en: **(i) The used car: no.** It was produced, and counted, in the year it was made; selling it again produces nothing new. (A dealer's margin on it does count: that is a service produced now.)
items.zh: **(i) 二手车：不算。** 它在生产的那一年已经算过了；再卖一次没有生产出新东西。（经销商从中赚的差价算：那是现在提供的服务。）

items.en: **(ii) The flour: no.** It is an *intermediate* good, used up in making pizzas. Its value is already inside the price of the pizza; counting it again would count it twice.
items.zh: **(ii) 面粉：不算。** 它是*中间*品，在做比萨时用掉了。它的价值已经包含在比萨的价格里；再算一次就重复计算了。

items.en: **(iii) The pension: no.** It is a *transfer*: money moves from taxpayers to retirees, but nothing is produced in exchange. (When the retiree spends it, that spending counts, as consumption.)
items.zh: **(iii) 养老金：不算。** 它是*转移支付*：钱从纳税人转到退休者手里，但没有生产任何东西作为交换。（退休者把钱花掉时，那笔支出算作消费。）

items.en: **(iv) The new house: yes.** It is a final good produced in 2025. In the expenditure approach, $Y = C + I + G + NX$, it counts as **investment** $I$, not consumption.
items.zh: **(iv) 新房：算。** 它是 2025 年生产的最终品。在支出法 $Y = C + I + G + NX$ 里，它算作**投资** $I$，不算消费。

title.en: Money, prices and the interest rate

paras.en: The money supply grows 8% a year, real GDP 3% a year, and the velocity of money is constant. Use the quantity theory of money to find the inflation rate. If lenders want a real interest rate of 2%, what nominal interest rate will they charge?
paras.zh: 货币供应量每年增长 8%，实际 GDP 每年增长 3%，货币流通速度不变。用货币数量论求通胀率。如果贷款人要求 2% 的实际利率，他们会收多少名义利率？

text.en: Total spending on output can be counted two ways. As money times how often it is spent: $M \times V$. Or as the price level times real output: $P \times Y$, which is nominal GDP. They are the same spending, so:
text.zh: 花在产出上的总支出可以用两种方法数。一种是货币量乘它被花的次数：$M \times V$。另一种是价格水平乘实际产出：$P \times Y$，也就是名义 GDP。两者是同一笔支出，所以：

blocks.tex: M V = P Y \quad\Rightarrow\quad \%\Delta M + \%\Delta V \approx \%\Delta P + \%\Delta Y

text.en: (For growth rates, a product becomes a sum.) If velocity is constant, money growing faster than real output must show up as rising prices: inflation is money growth minus real growth. That is the quantity theory's long-run message: inflation is, at bottom, too much money chasing too few goods.
text.zh: （对增长率来说，乘积变成和。）如果流通速度不变，货币增长快于实际产出增长的部分，必然表现为价格上涨：通胀率 = 货币增长率 − 实际增长率。这就是货币数量论的长期结论：通胀说到底是太多的钱追逐太少的商品。

text.en: A lender who wants 2% more *goods* back next year must also be paid for the 5% by which each dollar will have lost value. So the **nominal** interest rate is roughly the real rate plus expected inflation: the **Fisher equation**, $i \approx r + \pi$. Central banks work through it: by setting the nominal rate (in Australia, the RBA's cash rate) above or below inflation, they make borrowing dearer or cheaper in real terms.
text.zh: 贷款人如果想明年多收回 2% 的*商品*，还得补偿每块钱贬值的 5%。所以**名义**利率约等于实际利率加预期通胀：这就是**费雪方程**，$i \approx r + \pi$。中央银行就是通过它起作用的：把名义利率（在澳大利亚是 RBA 的现金利率）定得高于或低于通胀，让借钱在实际上变贵或变便宜。

prompt.en: Money grows 8%, velocity is constant, and real output grows 8% too. What does the quantity theory predict for inflation?
prompt.zh: 货币增长 8%，流通速度不变，实际产出也增长 8%。货币数量论预测通胀是多少？

feedback.en: Only if real output does not grow.
feedback.zh: 只有实际产出不增长时才是。

feedback.en: Real growth is subtracted, not added.
feedback.zh: 实际增长率要减去，不是加上。

label.en: About zero: the extra money buys the extra output
label.zh: 大约为零：多出来的钱买的是多出来的产出

say.en: The quantity theory in growth rates.
say.zh: 增长率形式的货币数量论。

say.en: Money grows 8%, velocity is constant, real output grows 3%:
say.zh: 货币增长 8%，流通速度不变，实际产出增长 3%：

say.en: Inflation: money growth beyond real growth.
say.zh: 通胀率：货币增长中超出实际增长的部分。

say.en: The Fisher equation: the real rate plus inflation.
say.zh: 费雪方程：实际利率加通胀率。

outro.en: **Answer:** inflation is about 5%; lenders charge a nominal rate of about 7%.
outro.zh: **答案：** 通胀约 5%；贷款人收取约 7% 的名义利率。

paras.en: **c.** (i) No: produced and counted in an earlier year (only a dealer's margin counts). (ii) No: an intermediate good, already included in the pizza's value. (iii) No: a transfer payment, not payment for production. (iv) Yes: a final good produced in 2025, counted as investment.
paras.zh: **c.** (i) 不算：在以前的年份生产并计算过（只有经销商的差价算）。(ii) 不算：中间品，已包含在比萨的价值里。(iii) 不算：转移支付，不是对生产的报酬。(iv) 算：2025 年生产的最终品，计入投资。

paras.en: **d.** $MV = PY \Rightarrow \%\Delta M + \%\Delta V = \%\Delta P + \%\Delta Y$: $8 + 0 = \pi + 3$, so $\pi = 5\%$. Fisher: $i \approx r + \pi = 2 + 5 = 7\%$.
paras.zh: **d.** $MV = PY \Rightarrow \%\Delta M + \%\Delta V = \%\Delta P + \%\Delta Y$：$8 + 0 = \pi + 3$，所以 $\pi = 5\%$。费雪方程：$i \approx r + \pi = 2 + 5 = 7\%$。

text.en: Where the marks are: in (c) a reason for each item, taken from the definition of GDP; in (d) the quantity equation written in growth rates before you use it.
text.zh: 得分点：(c) 每一项都要从 GDP 的定义给出理由；(d) 先写出增长率形式的数量方程，再代数。

title.en: Policy, and the other ways to measure GDP
title.zh: 政策，以及衡量 GDP 的其他方法

items.en: **Three ways to measure GDP**, which must agree: total spending on final goods ($C + I + G + X - M$); total value added (each firm's sales minus its purchases from other firms, which is how intermediate goods are kept out); total income (wages, profits, rent, interest).
items.zh: **衡量 GDP 的三种方法**，结果必须一致：最终品的总支出（$C + I + G + X - M$）；总增加值（每家企业的销售额减去从其他企业买的投入，中间品就是这样被排除的）；总收入（工资、利润、租金、利息）。

items.en: **What GDP misses**: home production, leisure, the environment, how income is shared. It measures production, not well-being.
items.zh: **GDP 漏掉的东西**：家庭劳动、闲暇、环境、收入怎么分配。它衡量的是生产，不是福祉。

items.en: **Monetary policy**: the central bank raises its cash rate to cool spending and inflation (borrowing dearer, saving more attractive, a stronger dollar), and lowers it to support spending.
items.zh: **货币政策**：央行提高现金利率来给支出和通胀降温（借钱更贵、储蓄更有吸引力、本币走强），降低利率来支持支出。

items.en: **Fiscal policy**: government spending and taxes. More spending or lower taxes raise total demand in the short run; financed by borrowing, they can push interest rates up.
items.zh: **财政政策**：政府支出和税收。增加支出或减税在短期内提高总需求；如果靠借债融资，可能推高利率。

items.en: **A business reads all of this** as its environment: real growth for demand, inflation for costs and prices, interest rates for the cost of investment.
items.zh: **企业把这些都看作自己的经营环境**：实际增长关系到需求，通胀关系到成本和定价，利率关系到投资的成本。

items.en: Valuing real GDP at the current year's prices instead of the base year's.
items.zh: 用当年价格而不是基年价格算实际 GDP。
把中间品或转移支付算进 GDP。

items.en: Adding real growth to money growth in the quantity theory instead of subtracting it.
items.zh: 在货币数量论里把实际增长率加上，而不是减去。

prompt.en: Nominal GDP is 5500 and real GDP (at base-year prices) is 5000. What is the GDP deflator?
prompt.zh: 名义 GDP 是 5500，实际 GDP（按基年价格）是 5000。GDP 平减指数是多少？

explain.en: $5500/5000 \times 100 = 110$: prices are 10% above the base year.

prompt.en: Money grows 6% a year, real output 2%, velocity is constant. What is inflation, in percent?
prompt.zh: 货币每年增长 6%，实际产出增长 2%，流通速度不变。通胀率是百分之几？

prompt.en: Which of these counts in this year's GDP?
prompt.zh: 下面哪项计入今年的 GDP？

label.en: A new machine bought by a bakery this year
label.zh: 面包店今年买的一台新机器

label.en: Shares bought on the stock market

feedback.en: A financial transaction: ownership changes hands, nothing is produced.
feedback.zh: 金融交易：所有权换手，没有生产任何东西。

explain.en: The machine is a final good produced this year, counted as investment.
explain.zh: 机器是今年生产的最终品，计入投资。
